name: Wawai Mail
description:
Wawai Mail lets you run real email marketing campaigns entirely through conversation with your AI assistant, no dashboard to learn, no separate app to open.

Connect your contacts from Airtable, Google Sheets, an uploaded spreadsheet, or Wawai's own built-in contact store. Describe the email you want, and your assistant builds it, including embedded images and a legally-required unsubscribe link and business address. Send yourself a real test copy before it goes out, preview exactly who it'll reach, then confirm the send with one clear approval step.

After sending, ask for delivery, open, and click data on any campaign, right in the same conversation. Every account gets 1,000 free emails for life; after that, sending is billed per campaign against a simple prepaid balance, no subscriptions, no per-seat pricing.

Built for small businesses and marketers who already trust their AI assistant with real work, and would rather describe what they want to send than fight with a campaign builder UI.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wawai Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wawai Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wawaipartners.com/email. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wawai Mail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wawai Mail lists 22 MCP tools, including add_contact, check_domain_verification_status, confirm_send, connect_custom_domain, connect_data_source, delete_segment, get_campaign_config, get_campaign_image_upload_url, get_campaign_opens, get_campaign_report, get_campaign_status, and get_credit_balance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wawai Mail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wawai Mail in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Wawai Mail MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wawai Mail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wawai Mail is developed by Wawai Partners. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
